subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.**

She had the **__temerity__** to call her teacher a liar.
solution: The correct answer is **"impudence."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Temerity"** means audacity or boldness. (अत्यधिक विश्‍वासभरा आचरण जिसमें रुखेपन की झलक मिलती है; दुस्साहस, धृष्टता) • **Example:** *He had the **temerity**__ to call the teacher a liar!* • **"Impudence"** also means audacity or boldness. (निर्लज्जता, अशिष्‍टता) __ • **Example:** *With a hint of **impudence**__ she told him not to talk.* • Therefore, **impudence** is the most appropriate synonym for **temerity** in this context. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Tedious **means boring or repetitive. (उबाऊ और (समय की दृष्टि से) लंबा) • **Taciturn** means reserved or uncommunicative. (अल्पभाषी (अमित्रवत ढंग से); कम बोलनेवाला, चुप्पा) • **Trenchant** means sharp or incisive. (तीखा) 47:Tf9a, The correct answer is **"challenge."**
